scope: scripts/qualify_plcsim_gaps.py (runtime corpus) on Debug builds of 53f9d751 (the watch; fedf1231 later changes only sim_record's ownership gate) with one owned PLCSIM Advanced V8 CPU1511 instance on Softbus of a scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 and one owned TIA Portal V21 Update 3. Before the first code-change simulation_download_online: sim_observe watch collect without a start refused SimulationWatchInactive, a second start SimulationWatchActive, and an idle watch with a 2000 ms collect window reported no software- or hardware-configuration event; then a watch started before the download and collected after it (1000 ms window) held one softwareConfiguration event SRSCC_SOFTWARE_CHANGED_IN_STOP with errorCode OK, raised during the other tool call. The rest of the existing gaps corpus passed unchanged.
limitations: Software configuration only: the download changed no hardware configuration, so a hardwareConfiguration event and an IP change within a watch are not exercised natively (IP changes have local.plcsim.signals-ip.20261102 in a bounded window).
One owned Softbus CPU 1511 instance; other CPUs, firmware and TCP/IP instances are not qualified.
